name: Voxel-Sequential Access via VoxelBlockManager
definition: A linear iteration paradigm over only active voxels in the order defined by Index-Grid, using the VoxelBlockManager (VBM) to encode the inverse map from sequential active-voxel index to tree position (leaf and in-leaf offset).
summary: Voxel-Sequential Access via VoxelBlockManager provides a global, contiguous index space for active voxels across leaf boundaries, enabling strict sequential access without random tree traversal overhead.
